body: After ※6⛬ carefully put away the items he had purchased, he set off on his way home.
Before long, his figure appeared outside his yard.
The ※2⛬ in the yard had extremely keen hearing and instantly detected the movement; its small figure immediately became lively, scurrying happily towards ※6⛬.
It circled around ※6⛬ nonstop, continuously calling out, “※5⛬, ※5⛬…”
※6⛬ looked at ※5⛬'s excited appearance, naturally understanding its thoughts.
It must have been asking:
“Master, why did it take you so long to come back? Your ※3⛬ worked out very diligently today. Did Master bring me any gifts?”
※6⛬ smiled, gently stroked ※2⛬’s round little belly, and said softly,
“Yes, I specifically brought you a wonderful gift.”
Upon hearing this, ※2⛬’s eyes instantly lit up, and it excitedly cried out,
“※2⛬… ※2⛬… Really? Master, what kind of gift is it?”
※6⛬ said mysteriously,
“It’s definitely a good thing. I’ll put it away first, and then I’ll give it to you.”
※5⛬ was filled with anticipation upon hearing this, excitedly bouncing in place,
imagining what kind of surprise gift its Master would bring it, becoming more and more excited the more it thought about it.
※6⛬ quickly entered the house, and soon placed the things he bought in his room, then came out holding a box.
Seeing this, ※2⛬ immediately moved closer impatiently, its small eyes sparkling with excitement and curiosity.

※6⛬ didn't keep him in suspense and directly opened the box. ※2⛬ quickly leaned forward to look, but what came into view were only some metal rings. It was instantly stunned, filled with confusion and disappointment.
It really didn't understand what use this so-called gift had; it couldn't be eaten or drunk. What kind of good thing was this?
※6⛬ looked at ※2⛬'s dejected expression and explained with a smile,
“※2⛬, don’t underestimate this thing. It can help you train better.”
As soon as ※2⛬ heard this, its excited expression instantly collapsed, and it felt even more disappointed.
It thought to itself,
“Sigh, I didn't expect it to be something related to training again. Why is my ※3⛬’s life so hard?”
※6⛬ saw ※2⛬'s unhappy appearance but did not heed its emotions. Instead, he directly put the metal rings on ※2⛬.
※2⛬ felt its body sink, and instantly felt that whatever movement it made became extremely awkward, as if an invisible force was restraining it,
requiring greater strength to move freely, and its body was far less flexible than before.
It felt very uncomfortable and instinctively wanted to take this thing off.
Just then, ※6⛬’s voice rang out sternly,
“※2⛬, you must wear this thing all the time. You are not allowed to take it off.”
Upon hearing such a strict command from its Master, ※2⛬ knew that even if it was unwilling, it could only obey obediently.
Its heart was full of grievance, and it couldn't help but cry out loudly,
“※2⛬, ※2⛬…” ※6⛬ naturally understood ※2⛬’s meaning.
This little guy was clearly protesting, protesting that he had deceived it, promising a gift, but it turned out to be something that made it uncomfortable, not caring about its feelings at all.
※6⛬ couldn't help but find ※5⛬’s cute and wronged appearance amusing.
However, he did not change his mind. ※2⛬’s protest was ultimately ineffective, and it could only helplessly continue training with this forced training device.
※6⛬ watched for a while, and seeing that ※2⛬ had gradually adapted, he turned and went back to the house, preparing to check the valuable data he had collected today.
After ※6⛬ returned to his room, he eagerly began to check the status of the ※7⛬ he had investigated today. His system had already summarized and analyzed all the data, waiting for him to review it.
Today, ※6⛬ investigated many different types of ※7⛬, and in this process, he discovered some quite interesting commonalities.
Firstly, every ※7⛬, regardless of its attribute, had a ball of light within its body. ※6⛬ speculated that this should be a gathering place for energy.
Through comparison, he found that powerful ※7⛬ often had larger and brighter light balls, while weaker ※7⛬ had relatively smaller light balls.
Furthermore, all ※7⛬ had energy channels within their bodies.
※7⛬ of different attributes had different colors for their energy channels.
For example, Fire-type ※7⛬ had red energy channels, Ground-type ※7⛬ had yellow, and Grass-type ※7⛬ had green.
If it was a multi-attribute ※7⛬, its internal energy would be a coexistence of two colors, roughly distributed in a seven-to-three ratio, with one attribute being primary and the other secondary.
Of course, there were also special cases where the proportion of the secondary attribute might be slightly more or less, but it would not exceed 50% at most, and not be less than 10% at least.
Based on the data collected so far, no exceptions beyond this range have been found.
Regarding aptitude, ※6⛬ discovered during the investigation that most ※7⛬ had ordinary aptitude, with only a small number belonging to the Superior level.
He also noticed that there was indeed a certain correlation between the level of aptitude and the贯通 (penetration/flow) of internal channels.
Superior level ※7⛬ clearly had more贯通 (penetrated/flowing) channels within their bodies than ordinary level ※7⛬.
Although ※6⛬ dared not assert that this was the only factor affecting aptitude, his previous conjecture was confirmed:
The more channels that are贯通 (penetrated/flowing), the faster the energy circulates, and naturally, the faster the strength improves, which is undoubtedly closely related to what ※4⛬s call aptitude.
Of course, he also understood that there might be other factors at play, but they just haven't been discovered yet.
However, these discoveries were enough to strengthen his confidence; he could more confidently clear energy channels for ※2⛬ in the future, helping him improve his aptitude.
However, the biggest discovery today was not the above, but that the number of energy channels within ※7⛬ was not consistent.
Some ※7⛬ had more channels, while others had fewer.

Initially, due to the limited number of ※7⛬ ※6⛬ investigated, he did not discover the pattern until more ※7⛬ were investigated. After in-depth analysis, the system came up with a conjecture and informed ※6⛬.
The system found that this was actually related to base stats. ※7⛬ with higher base stats had more internal channels and a more complex structure.
In addition, through comparative research on ※3⛬ and ※2⛬, ※6⛬ found that evolution also affects energy channels.
Perhaps it was because he didn't pay attention to the condition of ※3⛬'s channels when he first cleared them, and after ※2⛬ evolved, he was also unsure if there were significant changes.
Now, after investigating the channels within ※3⛬ at the breeding facility and combining it with ※2⛬'s situation, ※6⛬ found that the number of channels within the evolved ※2⛬ significantly increased.
This might be related to the increase in base stats, as mentioned before, the higher the base stats, the more internal channels there are.
When ※3⛬ evolves into ※2⛬, its base stats increase, and its energy channels naturally also increase.
※6⛬ felt this was quite reasonable.
Among the ※7⛬ ※6⛬ investigated today, ※0⛬ had the highest base stats, and the number of channels within its body was indeed more than ※2⛬.
This discovery further confirmed the correctness of the system's analysis.
As for whether there would be unexpected situations, ※6⛬ believed there shouldn't be too much deviation, after all, he collected data from many ※7⛬ today, and their base stats varied,
and the number of channels was also different. The statistical data had a certain scientific basis, so he was quite convinced by this result.
However, regarding his previous conjecture that if all the channels within a ※7⛬ were cleared, would its aptitude become ※1⛬, ※6⛬ still couldn't be sure.

After all, up to now, he had never seen a ※7⛬ with ※1⛬ aptitude, nor did he know if all its internal channels were cleared. Lacking real data for reference, this could only be considered a speculation for now.
At this moment, a hint of curiosity arose in ※6⛬'s mind. A ※2⛬ with 450 base stats and a ※0⛬ with 500 base stats, both having different numbers of internal channels,
if all their channels were cleared, how should their aptitudes be defined?
Could both be considered ※1⛬?
But ※0⛬ has more internal channels, and if all of them are cleared, its energy circulation speed would definitely far exceed ※2⛬, and its strength improvement speed would also be faster.
In that case, could they still be considered to have the same ※1⛬ aptitude?
※6⛬ felt deeply puzzled about this, as this was also just a conjecture without data support, and for now, he could only ponder it in his mind.
data.title: Chapter 23 New Discovery
